title: "Warmup Schedule"
---

::: {.callout-note}
This chapter is under development.
:::

bgms uses a three-stage warmup schedule to tune MCMC sampler parameters.

## Stages

1. **Initial exploration** — Find reasonable step size
2. **Adaptation windows** — Estimate mass matrix, tune step size
3. **Final tuning** — Finalize step size
